system.description:
The effect of this skill is determined by the tag received from a Summon.
(Self: Fairy): +2 [Perception check]. 
(Self: Mythic): +2 [Athletics Check]. 
(Self: Undead): +2 [Endurance Check]. 
(Self: Construct): +2 [Disable Check]. 

(SR 2): The bonus becomes +1D.

A special skill that allows the summoned attendant to help with various tasks. The field of specialty differs depending on the type of follower.
